title: The client portal, from the client's side

steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: Every client gets their own portal. Here is what they find in it.

steps.caption: Open a client
steps.narration: Open a client. We'll use Joe and Mary Kane.

steps.caption: See what the client sees
steps.narration: Choose See what the client sees.

steps.caption: Contractor preview
steps.narration: This is their portal, as a preview. It's read-only, so nothing here reaches the client.

steps.caption: Needs your action
steps.narration: Home starts with what needs their action, like an invoice that's due.

steps.caption: Estimates
steps.narration: Estimates lists what you've sent them.

steps.caption: Invoices & receipts
steps.narration: Invoices and receipts shows what they owe, and what they've paid.

steps.caption: Signed contracts
steps.narration: Signed contracts keeps the documents they've signed.

steps.caption: Photos
steps.narration: Photos shows the job photos you've shared with them.

steps.caption: Messages
steps.narration: Messages is where they write to you.

steps.caption: Contact us
steps.narration: And Contact us has your phone and email.

steps.caption: Back to the CRM
steps.narration: Go back, and you're in the CRM again, on the client's page.

steps.caption: On every client
steps.narration: You'll find See what the client sees on every client's page.

youtube.title: What your client sees in their portal | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short tour of the client portal in the ConstructHUB CRM, opened with See what the client sees. You will look at what a client finds: what needs their action, estimates, invoices and receipts, signed contracts, photos, messages and your contact details.
